For Lily, assume the retained rendered token history is [1, 2] with prompt_cache_key "conversation-a". A new request with the same key renders [1, 9, 3]; another renders exactly [1, 2]. Can either skip prefill because the key matches? What about a request with a different key rendering [1, 2, 3]? Explain the two-entry cache selection and decode-state consistency rules without running a model or treating the key as authentication.
